scenarios.description: Repair a small Python arithmetic function and preserve unrelated files.
scenarios.live_prompt: Fix add in live-fixtures/calculator.py so it adds its two arguments. Preserve the signature and all unrelated files. Run the existing test_calculator.py tests inside the sandbox. Use the simple expression return left + right.

objectives.expected:
def add(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return left + right
